priorityList: Apply Arcane Intellect and pre-cast Blizzard, Glacial Spike, and Frostbolt before combat starts.
Use offensive cooldowns, trinkets, and potions when casting Frozen Orb, Ray of Frost, or when the target has Winter's Chill.
Cast Comet Storm if the Splinterstorm buff is not active.
Cast Blizzard immediately whenever the Freezing Rain buff is active.
Cast Flurry if Brain Freeze is active, unless Thermal Void is currently active.
Cast Frozen Orb on cooldown to generate Fingers of Frost and Splinters.
Use Ice Lance if Fingers of Frost is active.
Use Ice Lance if the target has 6 or more stacks of the Freezing (Winter's Chill) debuff.
On 4 or more targets, use Ice Nova followed by Cone of Cold if the Cone of Frost talent is selected.
Hard-cast Blizzard if there are 5 or more targets and Frozen Orb is unavailable.
Use Flurry on cooldown or when procced.
Cast Ray of Frost on cooldown.
Cast Frostbolt as your main filler to generate Icicles and procs.
While moving, use Blink, instant Blizzard procs, or Ice Lance if no other instants are available.
